description: fail-closed: a match used as an or_throw() receiver whose Result Err type is Int (not a `pub error`) must be rejected with E_OR_THROW_NOT_ERROR_TYPE. Regression: the or_throw preflight typed its receiver used_as_value=False, collapsing the match to Void, skipping the public-error check, and cascading to a weaker E_REQUIREMENT_NOT_SATISFIED (Int is Throw).
